sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the repaired applicability and same-ship concentration/result pairing. Additionally enforce the canonical datatypes for operatingArea (xsd:string) and foodWasteDischargeToSea (xsd:boolean) in the non-applicable branch, or factor those datatype constraints outside sh:or; otherwise invalidly typed values can evade the exact applicability test and pass accidentally. Keep the inclusive 12 MI_N threshold and the nearbyIceConcentration > 0.1 plus distanceFromAreaWithIceConcentrationAboveOneTenth recording requirement.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the applicability logic. The verified condition is operatingArea = "Arctic_waters" AND foodWasteDischargeToSea = true; arcticWaters must not be an additional conjunct that can make this condition appear non-applicable. The current sh:or therefore permits an accidental pass when operatingArea is Arctic_waters and discharge is true but arcticWaters is absent or different. Make the applicable branch enforce the exact two-term condition and make the non-applicable branch its exact negation, while retaining arcticWaters only as an independently required declared input if required by the contract. Keep the 12 MI_N inclusive threshold and the conditional recording requirement for distanceFromAreaWithIceConcentrationAboveOneTenth.

Repair the applicability logic as previously instructed. The non-applicable sh:sparql branch currently SELECTs the ship when operatingArea is not "Arctic_waters" OR foodWasteDischargeToSea is false; a non-empty SELECT result is a SHACL violation, so this branch rejects exactly the non-applicable cases instead of accepting them. Invert the SPARQL condition so it produces a result only when operatingArea = "Arctic_waters" AND foodWasteDischargeToSea = true, or encode the exact negation with portable SHACL Core. Retain arcticWaters only as the independently required declared input supported by the contract, and retain the inclusive 12 MI_N threshold and conditional recording requirement.

Applicability logic now matches the required operatingArea/discharge condition. However, the applicable branch still encodes the recording obligation as unrelated presence-only quantities: it does not establish that distanceFromAreaWithIceConcentrationAboveOneTenth is the distance associated with an area whose ice concentration exceeds 1/10. Encode that relationship explicitly using the supplied concentration operand and result on the same case/ship node, while retaining the conditional result requirement and the inclusive distanceToNearestLandIceShelfOrFastIce >= 12 MI_N check. Do not add an unverified alternative or threshold, and preserve the independently required arcticWaters input and all prior applicability repairs.

Preserve the repaired applicability and same-ship concentration/result pairing. Additionally enforce the canonical datatypes for operatingArea (xsd:string) and foodWasteDischargeToSea (xsd:boolean) in the non-applicable branch, or factor those datatype constraints outside sh:or; otherwise invalidly typed values can evade the exact applicability test and pass accidentally. Keep the inclusive 12 MI_N threshold and the nearbyIceConcentration > 0.1 plus distanceFromAreaWithIceConcentrationAboveOneTenth recording requirement.
